entries.title: Genesis 25:1
segments: ¶Abraham again took a wife, and her name [was] Keturah.

entries.title: Genesis 25:2
segments: And she bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

entries.title: Genesis 25:3
segments: Jokshan begot Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

entries.title: Genesis 25:4
segments: And the sons of Midian [were] Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abidah, and Eldaah. All these [were] the children of Keturah.

entries.title: Genesis 25:5
segments: And Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac.

entries.title: Genesis 25:6
segments: But Abraham gave gifts to the sons of the concubines which Abraham had; and while he was still living he sent them eastward, away from Isaac his son, to the country of the east.

entries.title: Genesis 25:7
segments: This [is] the sum of the years of Abraham's life which he lived: one hundred and seventy-five years.

entries.title: Genesis 25:8
segments: Then Abraham breathed his last and died in a good old age, an old man and full [of years], and was gathered to his people.

entries.title: Genesis 25:9
segments: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, which [is] before Mamre, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite,

entries.title: Genesis 25:10
segments: the field which Abraham purchased from the sons of Heth. There Abraham was buried, and Sarah his wife.

entries.title: Genesis 25:11
segments: ¶And it came to pass, after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac. And Isaac dwelt at Beer Lahai Roi.

entries.title: Genesis 25:12
segments: Now this [is] the genealogy of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's maidservant, bore to Abraham.

entries.title: Genesis 25:13
segments: And these [were] the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

entries.title: Genesis 25:14
segments: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

entries.title: Genesis 25:15
segments: Hadar, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

entries.title: Genesis 25:16
segments: These [were] the sons of Ishmael and these [were] their names, by their towns and their settlements, twelve princes according to their nations.

entries.title: Genesis 25:17
segments: These [were] the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred and thirty-seven years; and he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.

entries.title: Genesis 25:18
segments: (They dwelt from Havilah as far as Shur, which [is] east of Egypt as you go toward Assyria.) He died in the presence of all his brethren.

entries.title: Genesis 25:19
segments: ¶This [is] the genealogy of Isaac, Abraham's son. Abraham begot Isaac.

entries.title: Genesis 25:20
segments: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah as wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian.

entries.title: Genesis 25:21
segments: Now Isaac pleaded with the LORD for his wife, because she [was] barren; and the LORD granted his plea, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

entries.title: Genesis 25:22
segments: But the children struggled together within her; and she said, "If [all is] well, why [am I like] this?" So she went to inquire of the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 25:23
segments: And the LORD said to her: "Two nations [are] in your womb, Two peoples shall be separated from your body; [One] people shall be stronger than the other, And the older shall serve the younger."

entries.title: Genesis 25:24
segments: So when her days were fulfilled [for her] to give birth, indeed [there were] twins in her womb.

entries.title: Genesis 25:25
segments: And the first came out red. [He was] like a hairy garment all over; so they called his name Esau.

entries.title: Genesis 25:26
segments: Afterward his brother came out, and his hand took hold of Esau's heel; so his name was called Jacob. Isaac [was] sixty years old when she bore them.

entries.title: Genesis 25:27
segments: So the boys grew. And Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field; but Jacob was a mild man, dwelling in tents.

entries.title: Genesis 25:28
segments: And Isaac loved Esau because he ate [of his] game, but Rebekah loved Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 25:29
segments: ¶Now Jacob cooked a stew; and Esau came in from the field, and he [was] weary.

entries.title: Genesis 25:30
segments: And Esau said to Jacob, "Please feed me with that same red [stew], for I [am] weary." Therefore his name was called Edom.

entries.title: Genesis 25:31
segments: But Jacob said, "Sell me your birthright as of this day."

entries.title: Genesis 25:32
segments: And Esau said, "Look, I [am] about to die; so what [is] this birthright to me?"

entries.title: Genesis 25:33
segments: Then Jacob said, "Swear to me as of this day." So he swore to him, and sold his birthright to Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 25:34
segments: And Jacob gave Esau bread and stew of lentils; then he ate and drank, arose, and went his way. Thus Esau despised [his] birthright.
